description: End-to-end /ask checks against the pilot publication. 'expected' lists [law title fragment, provision label] pairs; a case passes when the answer cites at least one of them and its status is allowed. Negative cases must not be answered as if the collection covered them. These are development checks, not a held-out benchmark or a certification of legal accuracy.

history.content: Does a seller have to give a purchaser a receipt under the Punjab Consumer Protection Act 2005?
Yes. Section 19 of The Punjab Consumer Protection Act 2005 requires every manufacturer or trader who sells goods to issue a receipt [1].
